[Some of you might be facing an unavailability of 5G services issues in your realme 5G smartphones. So this thread might be helpful for those whose facing any such issues.

Issue:- Unavailability of 5G Services and Troubleshooting method

For Jio Operator:-Please make sure that your current area supports Jio 5G service. Jio 5G is now supported in some areas in major cities like Delhi, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Hyderabad, etc. You can search your city for supported 5G areas from MyJio Application/official website.

Note:It may be possible that most area of that city has the availability of 5G network, but some of the areas may not have 5G Coverage.

1.The steps to check if 5G network is available in that area or not
Go to Mobile Settings-->Select Mobile Network Option-->Select Sim Card (Sim 1 or Sim 2)
-->Preferred Network should be selected as 5G/4G/3G/2G Auto Mode
-->Select Operator (Turn off auto Select Option)>> Search Manual Network.

After following above steps, under search network if
Case 1 : Jio 5G or Jio True 5G is visible and selected, then it means in that particular area 5G network is available.
Case 2 : Jio 5G or Jio True 5G is not visible, then it means in that particular area 5G network is not available. In that case, you can directly contact with your Service Provider.
￼
2. You can also check 5G availability under MyJio Application.
Please ensure that you have formally requested to activate the Jio 5G welcome offer by following these steps:
a. Open the MyJio app on your device.
b. Locate the Jio True 5G FOR ALL offer within the app.
c. Click on the option that expresses your interest, typically labeled as I am interested.
d. Confirm your interest by selecting the Done option. This action will send an invitation to Jio expressing your intent to avail the 5G service.
e. Upon approval of your application by Jio, you will receive an SMS notification from Jio confirming the activation of the 5G service.
f. Additionally, Jio will directly send welcome notifications within the My Jio application.
￼
3. Jio is automatically upgrading the 4G Sim Card into 5G. if user phone is still not able to latch with 5G then please reboot the device and switch on or off the flight mode.

4. Customer can check with other 5G mobile phone as well.
Case 1 : If other Mobile is latching with the 5G Network and realme 5G mobile is not latching 5G, then user can visit realme Service Center or contact realme helpline number.
Case 2 : If Other Mobile is also not latching then it means such area do not have 5G network Coverage. For more details, you can directly ask from the Operator.


For Airtel Operator:

1.With Airtel Sim Card, Customer does not require any specific 5G Data Plan.
2.Your device must support 5G network and your Sim Card should be a 5G Sim Card.
3.Your area must have a 5G network Coverage in order to latch with the 5G network. You can also check with your friends or other family members if they are using 5G device and it is successfully latching with the 5G network then your device will also latch.
4.If still not latching with the 5G network please reboot your device.
5.If still facing problem, please reach out to Airtel or realme customer service.
]
